Class SecurityActionResource

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.rest.SecurityActionResource
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/securityaction") public class SecurityActionResource extends Object
REST controller for system security actions and user account transfers.

      @GetMapping("/spinoff/historybases") public List<ValueKeyHtmlSelectOptions> getSpinOffHistoryBases()

      @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')") @DeleteMapping("/{id}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Void> deleteSecurityAction(@PathVariable Integer id)
      Deletes an ISIN change event. Restricted to an administrator, because the event is shared data that only an administrator creates; the absence of applications is a precondition, not an ownership check.
